stem.en: Pictures A to D are in the card called Explore the setup. On a phone, scroll down to see it. They are best guesses from one real run. Put them in the order the walk made them.

explanation.en: B is the first best guess, a soft blur from step 1. D, at step 6, shows the big shapes of furniture. A, at step 15, is a room with soft edges, and C, at step 30, has the fine pattern on the rug. Big shapes settle before details.
